description: Forschungszentrum Jülich maintains bslib, a Python library for simulating AC- or DC-coupled battery storage using manufacturer-specific or generic parameters. Its repository documents a battery-parameter database assembled from PerMod and storage inspection sources. Users choose a battery model or generic type and provide an operating power profile; outputs are AC and DC power and state-of-charge time series. Geographic coverage is determined by the installation being modelled. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the software, while the README labels the resulting database CSV under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is that generic storage parameters cannot capture every manufacturer's efficiency, ageing or control strategy. bslib can represent distributed storage in electricity or building-energy simulations. The related catalogue ENTSO-E transparency platform supplies system-level historical data, not device simulation. No database CSV, battery data or software package was downloaded.
inputs: Battery type, parameters and operating power profile
name: bslib battery storage simulator
